COALESCE(ei.region, eri.enterprise_region) as dimension_code,
COALESCE(ei.nature_code, eri.enterprise_nature) as dimension_code,
COALESCE(ei.industry_code, eri.enterprise_industry) as dimension_code,
'ALL' as dimension_code,
COUNT(DISTINCT eri.enterprise_id) as enterprise_count, SUM(IFNULL(ri.construction_count, 0)) as construction_total, SUM(IFNULL(ri.investigation_count, 0)) as investigation_total
FROM enterprise_report_info eri LEFT JOIN report_info ri ON eri.report_id = ri.report_id LEFT JOIN enterprise_info ei ON eri.enterprise_id = ei.enterprise_id
WHERE 1=1
AND eri.period_id IN
#{periodId}

#{status}

AND ei.nature_code IN
#{nature}

#{industry}
GROUP BY eri.period_id, dimension_code
ORDER BY eri.period_id, dimension_code
